description: This file defines a Java interface 'Range' with generic type T, specifying methods for range operations such as checking overlaps, containment, and boundary values.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: A generic interface representing a range of values with methods to evaluate range relationships and properties.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Checks if this range occurs after another range or value.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Checks if this range occurs before another range or value.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns the ending value of the range.

methods.name: includes
methods.description: Checks if this range includes another range or a specific value.

methods.name: isPoint
methods.description: Determines if the range is a single point (start equals end).

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if this range overlaps with another range.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns the starting value of the range.
